_help: One entry per body; each works as source ('Outfit made for') and as target ('Your body mod'). Key = tool name of the body, also used in the output name (<Key>Refit_). 'xl' = the ArchiveXL {body} name (_<xl>.mesh), default = the key. 'archives' = file-name patterns of the body mod's .archive; it must replace the vanilla female body meshes listed in 'meshes'. 'game': true = the shape comes from the base game. 'hints' = words in an outfit's file name that mean 'made for this body' (a lower-case hint matches any case, one with capitals only exactly).
